description: Controlled vocabularies for the IIDS Portfolio site (https://aispeg.insight.uidaho.edu) — the institutional inventory of AI projects across University of Idaho units. Per ADR 0001 (https://github.com/ui-insight/AISPEG/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-product-lifecycle-taxonomy.md), each operational status carries a measurable verification rule that is enforced by lib/portfolio-verification.ts and CI.

value_groups.description: Operational ladder for a project — the day-to-day status IIDS tracks. Source of truth: lib/portfolio.ts. Each value's Verification_Rule is enforced by lib/portfolio-verification.ts on every PR.

values.Label: Idea
values.Description: Named with a unit-of-interest; not yet committed to build.
values.Verification_Rule: No committed operationalOwner OR no committed iidsSponsor; repoUrl empty or repo has zero commits.

values.Label: Approved
values.Description: Committed to build with named owner and sponsor; not yet under active development.
values.Verification_Rule: operationalOwners[0] set AND iidsSponsor set AND non-empty description; no liveUrl; repo (if present) has <10 commits OR no commits in last 14 days.

values.Label: Building
values.Description: Active development. Code exists but not yet for real users.
values.Verification_Rule: repoUrl set; lastCommitDate within last 60 days; no liveUrl (or liveUrl flagged liveUrlIsStaging:true); pilotCohort empty.

values.Label: Prototype
values.Description: Demo-able but quiet — feature-complete or paused.
values.Verification_Rule: pilotCohort empty; either lastCommitDate older than 30 days OR featureComplete:true.

values.Label: Piloting
values.Description: In use by a bounded, named cohort.
values.Verification_Rule: liveUrl set; pilotCohort populated with size > 0 and a bounded scope.

values.Label: Production
values.Description: In real institutional use beyond the pilot cohort.
values.Verification_Rule: Publicly-accessible artifact: liveUrl OR a public repoUrl (isPrivateRepo:false) for repo-as-artifact deliverables (infrastructure, scaffolds, appliances). productionScope and supportContact populated.

values.Label: Maintained
values.Description: In production but in maintenance-only mode.
values.Verification_Rule: Inherits production accessibility (liveUrl or public repo); no commits to main in last 90 days; no open feature issues — only bug-, security-, or chore-labeled.

values.Label: Sunsetting
values.Description: Being wound down with a planned successor.
values.Verification_Rule: sunsetDate (ISO) set; replacedBy populated — successor project slug or the literal 'manual-process'.

values.Label: Archived
values.Description: Stopped. Record kept for institutional memory.
values.Verification_Rule: liveUrl returns 404 / is null / domain dead, or (for repo-as-artifact) repoUrl is archived/deleted; service stopped.

values.Label: Tracked
values.Description: Externally-owned project IIDS observes but does not build.

value_groups.description: Stakeholder-facing rollup. Computed deterministically from ProjectStatus by lib/portfolio.ts:computePublicStage. The public surfaces (/portfolio cards primary chip, landing stat strip, /explore tile breakdowns) render this axis; operational status is only shown as a secondary detail on cards.

values.Label: Exploring
values.Description: Thinking about it / committed to build.
values.Verification_Rule: Rolls up from ProjectStatus values: idea, approved.

values.Label: Building
values.Description: Code exists; not yet for real users.
values.Verification_Rule: Rolls up from ProjectStatus values: building, prototype.

values.Label: Live
values.Description: In use today.
values.Verification_Rule: Rolls up from ProjectStatus values: piloting, production, maintained.

values.Label: Retired
values.Description: Done or winding down.
values.Verification_Rule: Rolls up from ProjectStatus values: sunsetting, archived.

values.Label: Tracked
values.Description: Not built by IIDS.
values.Verification_Rule: Rolls up from ProjectStatus value: tracked. Bypasses the operational ladder.

value_groups.description: Granularity of production reach. Required on ProjectStatus values production and maintained.

values.Label: Home Unit
values.Description: Accessible to all users in the project's home unit.

values.Label: Institution-Wide
values.Description: Accessible to all UI users.

values.Label: External
values.Description: Deployed beyond UI — partner institutions, open-source distribution, or self-hostable artifact consumed externally.

value_groups.description: Public-site disclosure level for a project's record.

values.Label: Public
values.Description: All fields shown publicly.

values.Label: Partial
values.Description: Entry acknowledged on the public site; deployment details (scope, timelines, configuration) embargoed.

values.Label: Internal Only
values.Description: Not shown on the public site.

value_groups.description: How a project relates to the AI4RA partnership (UI + Southern Utah University NSF GRANTED).

values.Label: Core
values.Description: AI4RA OSS project with a UI deployment — dual-destiny.

values.Label: Adjacent
values.Description: Related to AI4RA but not part of the partnership proper.

values.Label: Reference
values.Description: UI deployment consumes an AI4RA spec or tool.

values.Label: UI-Parallel
values.Description: UI work running alongside an AI4RA initiative.

values.Label: None
values.Description: No AI4RA relationship.

value_groups.description: By-problem axis for browsing the portfolio. Audience-facing labels written in a Dean's vocabulary (not technical jargon). Source of truth: lib/work-categories.ts. One project can sit in 2-3 categories.

values.Label: Working with documents
values.Description: Extracting, reviewing, or finding answers in documents — contracts, reports, RFPs, audit findings.

values.Label: Streamlining a process
values.Description: Mapping, automating, or removing bottlenecks from operational workflows.

values.Label: Coordinating people and time
values.Description: Calendars, schedules, daily registers, multi-party logistics.

values.Label: Reconciling accounts and records
values.Description: Financial reviews, audit cycles, matching transactions to source data.

values.Label: Executive visibility
values.Description: Dashboards, strategic alignment, portfolio-level rollups for leadership.

values.Label: Research administration
values.Description: Proposal lifecycle, awards, sponsor compliance, ORED operations.

values.Label: Searching institutional knowledge
values.Description: Retrieval and Q&A over policies, history, decisions — RAG-style.

values.Label: AI infrastructure
values.Description: LLM gateways, GPU stacks, agent platforms — the plumbing other projects run on, not a problem on its own.
